name: NEOPOST S.A. Actions Port. EO 1
summary: NEOPOST S.A., now known as Quadient SA, is a global provider of mailing and shipping solutions, business process automation, and customer experience management. The company offers equipment, software, and services to help businesses manage their customer communications and logistics, and it is headquartered in Bagneux, France. Quadient operates in various countries around the world.
